slices.goal: Create a shared config module (config.py) that reads AUTONOVEL_LANGUAGE from .env and provides get_language() to all pipeline scripts. Export all existing config vars (API_KEY, WRITER_MODEL, JUDGE_MODEL, REVIEW_MODEL, API_BASE, BASE_DIR, CHAPTERS_DIR, FAL_KEY, ELEVENLABS_KEY) from a single source of truth. English evaluation behavior must remain completely unchanged.

Export and metadata outputs reflect the configured language: epub_metadata.yaml shows lang: vi when language=vi, lang: en otherwise. LaTeX template renders Vietnamese diacritics correctly with EB Garamond and conditional babel support. state.json includes a language field propagated on load/save.

Validate that all prior slices (S02–S04) work together when AUTONOVEL_LANGUAGE=vi: the foundation phase produces Vietnamese world bible, characters, outline, canon, and honest evaluation scores from a Vietnamese seed concept.

tasks.narrative:
Generated manga prompts for Chapter 9 "Kẻ Đột Nhập" following the exact format established in ch08_prompts.md. Read the full chapter text, summary, ch08 reference format, and CHARACTER_SHEETS.md to ensure consistency.

The 4 trang structure follows the chapter's natural scene divisions:
- Trang 1: Phòng hồ sơ tối — Bách discovers Vòng 7 file, five names in blue ink, red ink revelation "Người thứ sáu: không rõ", written note about the forgotten person, then lights flash on and Cô Bích appears at the door.
- Trang 2: Cô Bích empathy — she steps in without locking the door, shows a thinner file with 6th person details (nam, Hương Thủy, thợ nước, calls rain), reveals her own sister was Rửa'd in 1985 (hand trembles, water ripples), gives Bách 10 minutes to copy.
- Trang 3: Warm glass & departure — Bách pockets the notebook (inner chest pocket, near heart), Cô Bích pushes glass of warm water ("Uống đi. Lạnh."), Bách drinks (warm, plain — Huế's way of saying "I care"), Bách turns back at door with fearful realization about rain being weaponized, Cô Bích offers counter-theory ("Hoặc đang cố giữ nhóm lại"), then lights off.
- Trang 4: Riverbank & quán — Bách at bến đá sông Hương with three lines of paper, Linh at quán bà Tâm with cold nước mía, Bà Tâm pours warm water and places a second glass nobody drinks, rain falls as Linh realizes someone is being Rửa'd right now.

Key design decisions:
- Used Bách(nam) as specified in task plan, referencing bach_nam_sheet
- Red ink visual shock limited to Trang 1 Panel 3 only (matching ch08's restrained use of visual shocks)
- Thematic threads woven across all 4 trang: red ink thread, warm water glass, touch/contact, rain
- Three distinct settings with clear palette transitions: fluorescent white → warm yellow → night black → rain gray
- 44 Vietnamese dialogue/caption entries throughout

tasks.title: Ch24: Trời Trong — manga prompts
tasks.description: Read ch24 full text. Write manga prompts. Three months later. Clear sky. Linh(nữ) at usual table. Five people gather — Lịch(nữ), Tuấn(now looks different post-Rửa but likely still nam based on text), Bách(nam), Duy(nữ). Duy announces leaving for Đà Nẵng. Cảnh(nam) — who sat outside 2000 nights — enters quán for first time, sits in the empty chair. Bà Tâm places glass before Cảnh. Group disperses slowly. Linh walks toward xưởng may in sunshine. Key scenes: clear sky establishing, each person arrives, Cảnh enters (first time inside), Bà Tâm's glass, goodbyes, Linh walks alone in sun. Characters: Linh(nữ), Lịch(nữ), Tuấn(nam), Bách(nam), Duy(nữ), Cảnh(nam), Bà Tâm. Settings: quán bà Tâm, đường phố Huế sáng. 4 trang — epilogue, warm tone, resolution.

decisions.rationale: Consistent with existing model config pattern (AUTONOVEL_WRITER_MODEL, etc.). python-dotenv already loaded in all scripts.

decisions.choice: Inline conditional instructions in each script
decisions.rationale: Minimal structural change. Each script already constructs its own prompts. Adding a conditional language instruction is the lightest approach for a single target language.
decisions.revisable: Yes — if adding more languages, refactor to shared prompt system

decisions.choice: Skip English regex, keep language-agnostic stats, LLM judge evaluates Vietnamese directly
decisions.rationale: English regex (banned words, AI tells, show-don't-tell) cannot match Vietnamese and would false-pass. Language-agnostic stats (sentence variation, em-dash density) still provide value. LLM judge handles quality assessment natively in any language.
decisions.revisable: Yes — add Vietnamese-specific patterns when research is done
